content: “Esiga niyo tei too goo maga peegoo diyaga, ayo goo susuga hagee nimapoo olo takaso.

Bei, odoo aboso nibada hu howo gisili moso ma kulodu egee molo taloso niba peegoo hasiso bigileiso. Osoloso odoo aboso tei too odoo ee piliguga, diayo goolee Godeeyo tou to dee goolai, biame ee sibileiso.
Esiga diayo goo hageesee nimapoo moodoolaiso. Bei, mo goo sabolo osoloso mo Mayo goo ee diba gooleedelega.

Esiga goo hagee ayo nimapoo olo takaso. Egeesi ma kulodu goo hagoso tei peledobooga, niba to ayo taka ee gooleebigileiso.” Dio Tei oso sibilei eyo goo taka “Esiga ayo daga Godeeyo tou bei mooloogolone a nibolo hodobo badebeiso. Goo egeesi maga, ayo goo hagee nimapoo takele.
Esino a epei odoo a diye di mapoo duso. Esino nima kulodu odoo heeso amapoo takolone, a kapoo diala, doloso koo woosa.
Esiga ayo takolone, a epei dileiso, dee taka goo ee niyo duloso niba diya ka gooholoso.

Esino ayo tei goo nimapoo ka taka. Ayo niba poogoloso duga, goo oso niba pidileiso. Bei, a duga, nei ayo Dio Tei nimapoo diye dalaiso, yayo niba pidilame. Esino a dilega poogooga, Dio Tei ee nimapoo sibileime.

Egeesi ma kulodu Dio Tei siboga, yayo mi odoo mapoo goo tokenee eyo goo maga tei goo takalaiso. Osoloso odoo Godeeyo howo woola tekepo dabalai goo onosee takalaiso. Osoloso Godeeye goo midilei goo eyo bei onosee takalaiso.
Esiga Dio Tei oso goo tokenee eyo goo maga tei goo takolone, amapoo tei tele pagalai goo ee mi odoo dia goo tokenee toowa ka moloso, dee takalaiso.
Osoloso a mo Ma mapoo hagee polo see niyo a agalaime. Goo ogoso Godeeyo howo woola tekepo badalai goo ee yilige bigileiso.
Osoloso Dio Tei oso Godeeye goo midili goo ee tei goo takolone, mi odoo dia goo ee midileiso, dee takalaiso. Bei, mi odoo dia wiligi odoo Saiteneeyo goo ee olo midiso.
Esiga amapoo goo bei moloso, ayo nimapoo takalai. Esino epedee niyo goo bei egee gooleedalai tebile. Esiga ayo goo egee nimapoo takalaime.

Esino Dio Tei oso nimapoo siboga, yayo niba tei goo susuga mapoo gilimado dileiso. Yayo eyo goolee takalaime. Esino yayo to ayo takeme du goo ee takomo sileiso. Osoloso hamamee goo ogoso peledabalai ee yayo nimapoo eligileiso.
Esiga Dio Tei oso to ayo yimapoo takalai ee see nimapoo takalaiso. Goo egeesi maga yayo mo hu dokodoo poudileiso.
Esiga goo susuga mo Maye toloso hagee molo ee mo. Goo egeesi maga ayo takolone, Dio Tei oso to ayo taka ee nimapoo takalaiso, dee ka taka.”
Goohele goo osogoomoga goo tosibileiso
“Biame deiyepo badoboso hamamee niyo a agalaime. Esino see biame deiyepo poogoloso hamamee niyo a see agalaiso.”

Esiga Yesuwo hamamee dili odoo aboso dieso nediliyo egeesee takaso, “Yayo imapoo takolone, biame deiyepo badoboso hamamee iyo yo agalaime, doloso see, biame deiyepo poogoloso hamamee iyo yo see ka agalai, dee taka goo eyo bei ee ogoobo? Osoloso yayo takolone, yo Ama mapoo dia, dee taka goo eyo bei ee ogoobo?
Osoloso yayo imapoo takolone, biame deiyepo, dee taka goo eyo bei ogoobo? Iba to yayo taka eyo bei medee koo gooleedo,” dee takemeleeso.

Yesuye o hamamee dili odoo oso yimapoo woosalo agalame debei goo ee, yo olo gooleedoloso dimapoo egeesee takaso, “Ayo nimapoo takolone, ‘biame deiyepo badoboso hamamee niyo a agalaime,’ dee taka sabolo osoloso, ‘see biame deiyepo poogoloso hamamee niyo a see ka agalai,’ dee taka goo omaga niyo amapoo woosalame ka dabala?
Egeesi ma kulodu ayo nimapoo taka. Niba gooholone pisileiso. Esino mi odoo ee goomogalaiso. O, tei takoo, niba goohalaiso. Esino goohele goo oso nimapoo goomoga goo tosibileiso.
Esiga niba medee goolee, soboso holo soomagoo biame omapoo yo dala teliso. Esino yo holo soomagoloso hamamee eyo dala too goo ee boobado bigiliso. Bei, yayo holope soomagoo goo maga diya goomogolone.

Esiga niba egeesi masi doso. Bei, niba epedee goohele sabolo doso. Esino a see wedi sibileso niba agalaiso. Eseega domo omapoo niba diya goomogalaiso. Goomoga goo hagee odoo heeso nimaga peedee dalaime.
Biame omapoo niyo goo hee talame amapoo woosalaime. Esino ayo nimapoo tei taka. Niyo ogoo goo talame mo hu maga Ma mapoo woosaga, yayo nimapoo tenelaiso.

Esiga niyo daga goo abo talame mo hu maga woosalo egele. Esino epedee hamaga dulone niyo ogoo goo talame mo hu maga woosaga, niyo goo egee talaiso. Eseega goomoga goo nimapoo egee molo ee kauwuleiso.”
Yesuye mi odoo dia wiligiodoo ee dagadi
“Esiga ayo goo susuga hagee takomo silone, wulo wudu takomo sileeso. Esino biame siboga, ayo goo susuga ee see nimapoo wulo wudu takomo sileime. Esino ayo Mayo goo ee nimapoo woola takomo sileiso.
Esiga biame omapoo nibada goo ee ayo Ma mapoo woosalaime. Bei, niyo nibada goo ee mo hu maga Ma mapoo woosamalaiso.
Bei, niyo tei tolone, a tei Ma maga simi doloso, a diya goolee sabolo egee do goo maga Maye niba diya sooloo dolone ka badoso.
Esiga ayo Maye badeli mi maga mipoo hamapoo simiso. Osoloso see epedee mipoo hagee poogoloso Maye badeli mi mapoo ka wedi poloso,” dee takaso.
Eseme o hamamee dili odoo oso yimapoo egeesee takaso, “Epedee nayo goo hagee imapoo wulo koo wudu takoo. Esino nayo goo susuga hagee imapoo woola yilige buguso.
Esiga iba tei toso, no tei Godee maga simiga. Bei, goo susuga ee no diya gooleedoo. Osoloso odoo heeso namapoo woosalame gooleemelee ee ogoloso daga nayo yimapoo nei takeliso,” dee takaso.
Eseme Yesuye nei egeesee takaso, “Niba epedee tei tosomo?
Esino niba medee dui. Biame olo sibileiso, osoloso olo simiso, niyo a poogoloso nibada mosopoo kukulo dilei. Esino a mobusomo koo badeli. Bei, mo Maye abolo hodobo badeliso.

Niyo amapoo tei too goo maga nimapoo mesie goo oso malame, ayo goo susuga hagee nimapoo olo takaso. Niba mipoo hamapoo dala ma kulodu dabalaiso. Esino niba ebilega medee kibiya debee. Bei, mipoo hagoso kitulugu ee ayo dagadileso ka badoso.”
